purpose: Independent public-data stress check after original synthetic mechanism FAIL, not an original author TabM reproduction or TabReD.
license: scikit-learn packaged reference datasets; no internet/download required

splits.data_group: Each seed an overlapping stratified real dataset split, NOT 5 independent dataset worlds

model.output: average K member predictive probabilities, not independent physical tasks

training.best_checkpoint_by: minimal validation ensemble NLL, per method; never test
training.train_all_methods: equal max candidate steps; selected checkpoint inference, report checkpoint

gate.mechanism_PASS: On both datasets, Mirror within 0.02 NLL and 0.01 AUC of native full fast weight at lower paid NPZ bytes, and genuine nonzero member diversity; not sufficient if native no-member single-forward Pareto-dominates.
gate.Mirror_specific_PASS: Mirror strictly better out-of-sample quality/storage/CPU P95 Pareto vs the strongest native equal-byte simple code and no-member, with validation-only selection.
gate.FAIL: Native no-member or simple linear-head/factorized code Pareto dominates, or no useful member diversity, or real heldout NLL/ROC AUC below trivial baseline.
gate.UNCERTAIN: Only two tiny real datasets, overlapping splits and no official TabM; no claim of long-term tabular drift or production inference.

provenance: Source hash and sklearn version in verification. Original synthetic observations cannot be relabeled. Store all 50 result rows and both validation-selected update counts; outcome-selected metric comparisons descriptive.
hardware: CPU AMD EPYC 9V74, PyTorch2.10 CPU FP32, sklearn 1.8, one BLAS/torch thread, no CUDA.
scientific_status: will stay UNTESTED MA until native original implementation and >10 independent natural datasets
